statements.text: With the introduction of US tariffs in 2025, automakers paused shipments, closed factories and held volumes at ports, leading to a year-on-year reduction in import and export volumes at the Port of Brunswick in Georgia.
Despite all the uncertainty about how tariffs will affect auto imports to the Port of Brunswick, a new record is about to be set.

The impact of US tariffs on vehicle imports had repercussions across vehicle ports in the US and abroad, with the initial 25% tariff effective from April causing carmakers to hold volumes at ports of export.
